1: Chapter 1: A Visitor on a Rainy Night
It had been raining in Qingshi for three whole days. Ever since Lin Xiaoyu's elder sister left for the capital, she had been the only one left to look after the town's small apothecary.
After dark, she closed the doors and windows, counted the day's earnings, blew out the oil lamp, and went upstairs.
No sooner had she lied down than a frantic knocking sounded from downstairs, followed by a man's voice: "Is anyone there?"
Standing outside the door was a young man soaked to the bone, his left arm wrapped in blood-stained strips of cloth. He said his name was Bai Yun and that he was with the Azure Dragon Society.
"I need my wound dressed," Bai Yun said in a low voice. "I can pay. Is three thousand five hundred wen enough?"
He produced a letter wrapped in oilpaper from his chest: "This letter must be delivered to Qingfeng before May 18th."
As she dressed the wound, he gave a bitter smile. "If my fiancée knew I was knocking on a girl's door in the middle of the night, she'd definitely be jealous."
Lin Xiaoyu did not take his money, saying only, "Tomorrow morning, I will take you up the mountain."
2: They set off at the first light of dawn. Lin Xiaoyu carried a bamboo basket on her back, packed with dry rations, medicinal herbs, and an old umbrella.

Halfway up the mountain, they encountered an old woodcutter named Zhou Dashan. The old man set down his axe and lowered his voice, telling them that yesterday evening, three outsiders had been at the town entrance asking about an injured young man.
"Xiaoyu, take the side paths," Zhou Dashan said. "The main road isn't safe." Lin Xiaoyu thanked him.
The side paths were narrow and slippery. Lin Xiaoyu led the way, her every step steady and sure. Bai Yun followed behind her in total silence.

The rain stopped by noon, and the mountain mist slowly cleared, revealing the rooftops of Qingfeng in the distance. Standing at the temple gates was a nun named Zhao Qiuyue, the guest master responsible for receiving visitors.
Zhao Qiuyue took the letter, glanced at the red seal on the closure, and nodded. "The abbot has been waiting two years for this letter."
Bai Yun said to Lin Xiaoyu, "I owe you my life." Lin Xiaoyu smiled. "Then next time you visit, help me fix the roof of my pharmacy." Bai Yun remained at the temple.
At dusk, Lin Xiaoyu descended the mountain alone. It was already dark by the time she reached home; she lit a lamp and sat behind the counter for a long time.
